risk_assessment.why_teacher_0_18795_is_not_enough: The teacher must improve from 0.1879528618 to 0.0400000000, an absolute reduction of 0.1479528618 and a relative reduction of 78.7181%. Its loss is 4.6988 times the target. Top-1 accuracy does not control probability quality: with error rate 1-0.9616262637=0.0383737363, every strict top-1 error has true-class probability below 0.5 and contributes more than ln(2). This alone gives an approximate lower bound of 0.0383737363*ln(2)=0.02660 before accounting for any loss on correct rows or severely wrong predictions. Reaching 0.040 would leave only about 0.01340 average-loss headroom beyond that optimistic error-bound contribution, whereas the measured teacher loss is 0.18795.
